description: Selected Countries - Geothermal Investments is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Geothermal, Renewable energy", published or maintained by World Bank Group. This dataset tracks investments in geothermal power projects by Multi-lateral Development Banks (MDBs) since the ‘70s and the Climate Investment Funds (CIFs) more recently. All the information by project has been obtained from public sources, primarily the MDBs’ and CIFs’ websites. Figures have been converted to constant 2010 USD. Coverage: 19 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa. It has 1 file in CSV. The portal files it under Geothermal, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
